info.description: A self-hosted GTD task manager. Authenticate with JWT (Authorization: Bearer <token>) or API key (X-Api-Key: <key>).
info.title: Runway

schema.title: Response List Users Admin Users Get

put.summary: Promote or demote a user (admin only)

get.description: Public so the login page can hide the register option when registration is closed, instead of inviting someone to type credentials and then refusing them. Discloses nothing: the same answer is obtainable by POSTing to /auth/register.
get.summary: Whether this instance currently accepts new registrations (public)

get.description: List tasks that have not been processed yet: no project and no tags assigned.
List tasks tagged +next — concrete actions you can do right now.

schema.title: Response Next Actions Gtd Next Get

get.description: Return all project names — both those inferred from tasks and those created explicitly.
List all pending tasks belonging to a specific project.

schema.title: Response Project Tasks Gtd Projects  Name  Get

get.description: List tasks tagged +someday — ideas and intentions not yet committed to.
List tasks tagged +waiting — things delegated or blocked on someone/something else.
Returns ok if the service is running.

post.description: Add a task to the inbox of the authenticated user. Accepts the same credentials as every other route — 'X-Api-Key: <key>' or 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' — and, for compatibility with existing agents, an API key in the Bearer slot. Intended for agents and automations.
post.summary: Add to inbox via API key

get.description: Return all pending tasks for the current user, sorted by urgency. Set include_done=true to also include completed tasks.

post.description: Create a new task. Optionally assign a project, tags, priority (H/M/L), due date, or make it recurring.

delete.description: Permanently delete a task. Use complete instead if you want to keep history.

get.description: Fetch a single task by its UUID, including all fields and annotations.

put.description: Update one or more fields of a task (description, project, tags, priority, due date, etc.). Only provided fields are changed.

post.description: Add a timestamped note or annotation to a task (e.g. progress update, context, link).
Mark a task as done. It will no longer appear in pending task lists.
Mark a task as in-progress. The task will show a start timestamp and be visually highlighted.
Remove the in-progress marker from a task without completing it.
